title: WHO announces start of Ebola vaccine clinical trial in DR Congo
english: The World Health Organization has launched a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test the effectiveness of the Ervebo vaccine against the specific Ebola strain driving the current, widespread outbreak. This initiative, known as the Tumaini trial, aims to protect high-risk individuals and will soon evaluate two additional vaccines developed by Oxford and Moderna. This effort comes as the region faces its deadliest Ebola crisis to date, with cases now spanning four African nations.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ክሊኒካዊ የክትባት ሙከራ ጀምሯል። 'ቱማኢኒ' (Tumaini) የተሰኘው ይህ ጥናት፣ ነባሩ የኢርቬቦ ክትባት በአሁኑ ወረርሽኝ ላይ ያለውን ውጤታማነት ለመፈተሽ እና ወደፊትም በኦክስፎርድ እና በሞዴርና የተዘጋጁ ሌሎች ክትባቶችን ለመሞከር ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በምስራቅ፣ መካከለኛው እና ምዕራብ አፍሪካ አገራት በስፋት እየተዛመተ ላለው እና እጅግ አስከፊ ለሆነው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) biyya Koongoo keessatti vaayirasii Iboolaa ittisuuf qorannoo talaallii haarawaa eegaleera. Qorannoon 'Tumaini' jedhamu kun, talaallii Ervebo jedhamu vaayirasii amma babal'achaa jiru kana irratti hojjetuu isaa kan qoratu yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraatti talaalliiwwan biroo kanneen Oksfoordii fi Moderna'n qopha'anis qorannoo kana keessatti kan hammataman ta'a. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, weerarri Iboolaa kun biyyoota Afrikaa gara garaa keessatti daran hammaachaa waan jiruuf, lubbuu namoota baay'ee baraaruuf jedhameeti.

title: Iran war live: Israel launches ‘targeted’ Hebron operation after attack
english: Israeli military forces have initiated a focused operation in Hebron following a deadly shooting incident that resulted in the deaths of two soldiers. Meanwhile, global oil prices have spiked due to escalating regional tensions and concerns over potential new American strikes against Iran. US President Donald Trump has suggested the possibility of conducting further military actions against Iranian targets.

oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el loltoonni lama ajjeefamuun walqabatee magaalaa Heebroon keessatti duula waraanaa kan eegalan yoo ta'u, rakkoo naannichaa kanaan walqabatee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dabalee jira. Gama biraatiin, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iran irratti haleellaa biraa raawwachuu akka danda'an eeraniiru.

title: Macklemore: ‘I say free Palestine’ as he kicks off a new tour
english: Rapper Macklemore has officially launched his new tour, which he has titled 'Free Palestine,' to express his support for the Palestinian cause. This marks his first stage performance since he was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour lineup due to his previous pro-Palestinian remarks. During his return, the artist emphasized his commitment to human rights and his belief that supporting humanity should not be a complex issue.
amharic: ራፐር ማክለሞር ለፍልስጤም ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመግለጽ 'ፍሪ ፍልስጤም' (Free Palestine) የተሰኘ አዲስ የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት ጀምረዋል። አርቲስቱ ስለ ፍልስጤም በሰጧቸው አስተያየቶች ምክንያት ከኤድ ሽራን የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት ከተሰናበቱ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ መድረክ ተመልሰዋል። በዚሁ መድረክ ላይም ሰብአዊ መብትን መደገፍ እና የሰው ልጅ መብት መከበር ቀላል ጉዳይ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Rapariin beekamaan Maklemoor deeggarsa inni ummata Filisxeemiif qabu agarsiisuuf 'Free Palestine' jedhuun daawwannaasaa jalqabeera. Inni waa'ee Filisxeem yaada isaa ibsachuu isaatiin walqabatee, daawwanna muuziqaa Eed Shiiran irraa erga ari'amee booda kun deebi'ee sagantaa isaa irratti kan mul'ateefi. Maklemoor sagantaa isaa kanaan mirga namoomaa fi namummaan sadarkaa addunyaatti dhimma salphaa ta'uu isaa hubachiiseera.

title: Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan, killing one and injuring 350
english: Typhoon Champi recently struck Taiwan, resulting in one death and over 350 injuries while causing significant damage to infrastructure and power outages. Thousands of residents were forced to evacuate as authorities issued urgent warnings regarding destructive winds and heavy rainfall. The storm is now moving toward China and Japan, leading to widespread flight cancellations and ongoing emergency preparations across the region.
amharic: ታይፉን ቻምፒ በታይዋን በመምታቱ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ ከ350 በላይ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፤ አውሎ ነፋሱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችን የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት እንዲያቋርጥ እና የህዝብ መፈናቀልን አስከትሏል። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው አደገኛ የንፋስ እና የዝናብ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀጥል በማስጠንቀቅ ህዝቡ ቤት ውስጥ እንዲቆይ መክረዋል። አውሎ ነፋሱ አሁን ወደ ቻይና እና ጃፓን በማምራት ላይ ሲሆን በአካባቢው የረጅም ርቀት በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ አድርጓል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Champi jedhamu kan Taayowaan rukute lubbuu nam tokkoo kan galaafate yoo ta'u, namoota 350 oliif miidhaa qaamaa geessiseera. Obomboleettiin kun mana jireenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduu kan mancaase yoo ta'u, namoonni kuma afur ol ta'an iddoo jireenyaa isaanii gadhiisuuf dirqamaniiru. Amma gara biyyoota Chaayinaa fi Jaappaanitti kan imalaa jiru obomboleettiin kun, balaliwwan xiyyaaraa hedduu akka haqaman taasiseera.

title: Kenya announces second Ebola death, says ‘no evidence’ of community spread
english: Kenya has reported a second fatality linked to an ongoing Ebola outbreak that originated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. While nine cases have been confirmed within a single specific group, health officials state that there is no indication of the virus spreading within the general community. Authorities are actively monitoring over one hundred individuals who had contact with the patients to prevent further transmission.
amharic: ኬንያ ከዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ በተዛመተ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ሳቢያ ሁለተኛ ሰው መሞቱን አስታውቃለች። በዘጠኝ ሰዎች ላይ ቫይረሱ ቢገኝም፣ የበሽታው ስርጭት በአጠቃላይ ማህበረሰቡ ውስጥ አለመኖሩን የጤና ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመቆጣጠር ከታማሚዎቹ ጋር ግንኙነት የነበራቸውን ከ130 በላይ ሰዎችን በክትትል ስር አድርገዋል።
oromo: Keeniyaatti namni lammaffaan dhibee Ebolaan lubbuun isaa darbuun ibsameera; dhibeen kunis biyya Koongoo irraa kan dhufe ta'uun beekameera. Dhukkubsattoonni sagal adda baafamanis, dhibeen kun hawaasa bal'aa keessatti akka hin babal'anne hojjettoonni fayyaa mirkaneessaniiru. Aangeyyoonni fayyaa tatamsa'ina dhibee kanaa to'achuuf jecha namoota dhukkubsattoota kana waliin walqunnamtii qaban 130 ol ta'an hordoffii cimaa jalatti galchaniiru.

title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
english: Former Ukrainian prisoners who were held alongside 74-year-old American Stephen Hubbard have reported that he suffered severe physical abuse and humiliation in Russian custody. Witnesses claim guards frequently beat, electrocuted, and mocked Hubbard simply because he was a US citizen. Hubbard was eventually released after spending over four years in prison following his capture in Ukraine in 2022.
amharic: ከአሜሪካዊው እስረኛ እስጢፋኖስ ሁባርድ ጋር በእስር ቤት የነበሩ የቀድሞ የዩክሬን እስረኞች፣ አዛውንቱ በሩሲያ እስር ቤት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ድብደባና ስቃይ ይፈጸምባቸው እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። ጠባቂዎቹ አሜሪካዊ በመሆናቸው ብቻ ሁባርድን በተደጋጋሚ እንደሚደበድቡትና እንደሚያዋርዱት ምስክሮቹ ይናገራሉ። በ2022 በዩክሬን ተይዘው ከአራት ዓመት በላይ በእስር የቆዩት ሁባርድ፣ በቅርቡ ከእስር ተለቀው ወደ ሀገራቸው ተመልሰዋል።
oromo: Namoonni biyya Yukreenii kan duraanii kan Stephen Hubbard jedhamuu fi umriin isaanii 74 ta'e waliin hidhamanii turan, jaarsa kana irratti dararri qaamaa fi gidirsuun cimaan raawwatamaa akka ture himan. Eegdonni mana hidhichaa Stephen Hubbard lammii Ameerikaa ta'uu isaatiin qofa doorsisuu, reebuu fi gidirsuu akka turan ragaaleen ni mirkaneessu. Hubbard bara 2022 Yukreen keessatti erga qabamee booda waggoota afur ol hidhaatti erga dararamee booda gadhiifamee gara biyya isaatti deebi'eera.

title: Why is Israel increasing its presence in the Balkans?
english: Israel is actively expanding its influence across the Balkan region by strengthening partnerships with local leaders. This collaboration focuses on key areas such as defense, surveillance technology, and political cooperation. Analysts suggest these moves are part of a broader strategy to solidify Israel's international standing and strategic interests in Europe.
amharic: እስራኤል በባልካን አገራት ከሚገኙ መሪዎች ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት በማጠናከር በክልሉ ያላትን ተጽዕኖ በስፋት እያሳደገች ነው። ይህ ትብብር በዋናነት በመከላከያ፣ በክትትል ቴክኖሎጂዎች እና በፖለቲካዊ ድጋፍ ዙሪያ ያተኮረ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ እስራኤል በአውሮፓ ያላትን ዓለም አቀፍ ተቀባይነት እና ስትራቴጂያዊ ጥቅም ለማስጠበቅ የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል እንደሆነ ይነገራል።
oromo: Isiraa'el naannoo Balkaanitti dhiibbaa ishee guddisuuf hogganoota naannoo sanaa waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa uumaa jirti. Walta'iinsi kun damee ittisaa, teeknoolojii hordoffii, fi deeggarsa siyaasaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu dha. Tarkaanfiin kun, Isiraa'el Awurooppaa keessatti aangoo fi faayidaa istiraateejii ishee jabeeffachuuf karoorfatte keessaa tokko ta'uu isaa ogeeyyonni ni ibsu.

title: Masked gunmen kill seven in attack on church funeral in Jordan
english: Two masked shooters attacked a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, Jordan, resulting in the deaths of seven individuals and injuring 34 others. Security teams are currently searching for the attackers while the Jordanian monarch has promised harsh consequences for those responsible. The King also called on the nation to remain united during this difficult time.
amharic: በዮርዳኖስ ካራክ ከተማ በሚገኝ የግሪክ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ውስጥ በተፈጸመ የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት ጥቃት ሁለት ጭንብል የለበሱ ታጣቂዎች ሰባት ሰዎችን ገድለዋል፣ 34 ሰዎችንም አቁስለዋል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙትን ወንጀለኞች በማደን ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ የዮርዳኖስ ንጉሥ ጥቃት አድራሾቹ ለፈጸሙት ድርጊት ተገቢውን ቅጣት እንደሚያገኙ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ንጉሡ ህዝቡ በአንድነት እንዲቆም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: ዮርዳኖስ keessatti namoonni lama fuula hidhatanii gara mana kiristaana Ortodoksii Giriikii dhaquun sirna awwaalchaa irratti dhukaasa bananiin, namoonni torba yeroo du'an 34 immoo madaa'aniiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa shakkamtoota kana hordofaa jiran yoo ta'u, mootichi ዮርዳኖስ namoota badii kana raawwatan irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu waadaa galeera. Akkasumas mootichi uummanni yeroo rakkinaa kana keessatti tokkummaasaa akka eeggatu dhaameera.

title: ‘Generation Right’: Israeli youth show strong support for the right
english: A recent poll indicates that approximately 75 percent of young Jewish Israelis voting for the first time identify with right-wing or centre-right political ideologies. This trend contrasts with global patterns where many young people lean toward the left, marking a significant shift for the upcoming Israeli elections. Experts attribute this move toward the right to the mainstreaming of extreme political figures and policies in the country's current governance.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ድምጽ የሚሰጡ ወጣት አይሁዳውያን እስራኤላውያን ወደ 75 በመቶ የሚጠጉት የፖለቲካ አቋማቸው ወደ ቀኝ ወይም መካከለኛ-ቀኝ ያዘነበለ ነው። በዓለም ዙሪያ ያሉ ወጣቶች ወደ ግራ ማዘንበል ቢታይባቸውም፣ በእስራኤል ግን ይህ አዝማሚያ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ተቃራኒ ሆኗል። ይህ ለውጥ የተፈጠረው በአገሪቱ ውስጥ አክራሪ የፖለቲካ አመለካከቶች እና ግለሰቦች ተቀባይነት በማግኘታቸው እንደሆነ ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: qorannoon dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, dargaggoonni Israa'el kan yeroo jalqabaaf sagaleesisan keessaa dhibbeentaa 75 kan ta'an, ilaalcha siyaasaa mirgaa ykn giddu-galeessa-mirgaa kan hordofan ta'uun isaanii beekameera. title: FCC Democrat warns broadcasters to resist Trump’s media pressure tactics
english: Anna Gomez, the only Democrat on the Federal Communications Commission, has urged major broadcasters to stand up against political pressure from the Trump administration. She criticized the industry's response to claims by FCC official Brendan Carr, who recently accused news outlets of spreading fake polls to influence upcoming midterm elections. Media advocates have rejected these accusations, arguing that they are politically motivated attempts to intimidate journalists.

oromo: miseensi mana maree kominikeshinii federalaa kan ta'an Anna Gomez, dhaabbileen miidiyaa dhiibbaa mootummaan Donald Trump irraan ga'u akka hin fudhanne akeekkachiisaniiru. Kunis, bakka bu'aan komishinichaa Brendan Carr miidiyaaleen filannoo irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf jecha qorannoo sobaa akka gabaasan himachuu isaanii hordofee kan dhufeedha. Haata'u malee, ogeeyyonni mirga gaazexeessitootaa himannaan kun bilisummaa miidiyaa ukkaamsuuf kan karoorfamee fi siyaasa irratti hundaa'e akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Time ‘running out’ to reach Yemen’s Taiz amid deepening crisis, UN says
english: The United Nations reports that a three-week blockade by Houthi forces in Yemen’s Taiz city has left over 800,000 residents without essential aid. Essential supplies like fuel, food, and water have become scarce and expensive, creating a severe humanitarian crisis. International officials warn that time is running out as intense fighting prevents humanitarian access and threatens the survival of local hospitals and families.
amharic: በየመን ታኢዝ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ለሦስት ሳምንታት በተጣለው ከበባ ምክንያት ከ800 ሺህ በላይ ነዋሪዎች አስቸኳይ ዕርዳታ ማግኘት አለመቻላቸውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አስታውቋል። የምግብ፣ የነዳጅ እና የንፁህ ውሃ አቅርቦት በመቆራረጡና ዋጋቸውም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ተከስቷል። ቀጥተኛ ግጭቱ የዕርዳታ አቅርቦትን እና የሆስፒታሎችን አገልግሎት ስላስተጓጎለ፣ በከተማዋ ያለው ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Mootummooni Gamtooman akka ibsanitti, magaalatti Ta’iz kan Yeman keessatti humnoonni Huti torban sadiif baadiyyaa fi daandiiwwan cufuun namoota 800,000 ol ta’an gargaarsa dhorkatanii jiru. Nyaanni, bizzaniin fi bishaan dhugaatii akkaataa itti dhabamee fi gatiin isaa waan dabaleef rakkoon namoomee hammaatee jira. Waraanni fi kahuun daandii gargaarsaa dhibdee kana daran hammeessee waan jiruuf, jireenyi namoota kanaa balaa hamaa keessa akka jiru ibsameera.

title: Israeli air strikes in Gaza City kill two Palestinians, wound several
english: Two Palestinians died and multiple people were injured following an Israeli airstrike in the al-Nasr neighborhood of Gaza City on Friday. A second attack near a local restaurant also resulted in additional injuries. These incidents occurred as part of ongoing military operations in the region.

oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa qilleensaa Israa'el iddoo Al-Nasr jedhamu irratti raawwatameen namoonni Palastaayinii lama ajjeefamanii kan biroon hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaa biraa mana nyaataa tokko cinaatti raawwatameenis namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Haleellaawwan kun duula waraanaa naannichatti geggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan raawwataman dha.

title: Israeli raids, demolitions and settler attacks hit Palestinians across West Bank
english: Israeli forces and settlers conducted widespread raids, demolitions, and violent attacks across the occupied West Bank on Friday. Authorities destroyed Palestinian businesses and homes in Hebron, restricted movement in several areas, and forcibly displaced landowners from their property. Additionally, settlers assaulted local residents and attempted to set fire to a home while protected by security forces.

oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata darbe humnoonni Israa'el fi qonnaan bulaanni biyya isaanii fudhatan bakkeewwan adda addaa Qileensa-Dhihaa keessatti haleellaa fi diiggaa gaggeessaniiru. Humnoonni Israa'el magaalaa Heebroonitti qabeenyaa fi manneen jireenyaa kanneen warra Falasxiim diiguun akkasumas daandiiwwan cufuun sochiin namootaa akka daabatu taasisaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, namoonni qonnaan bulaa ta'an haleellaa fi dhiibbaa irra kan ga'an yoo ta'u, manneen isaanii irraa akka gadi bahan dirqisiifamaniiru.

title: Israeli occupation ‘main source of instability’ in region: Egypt, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan say
english: Foreign ministers from Egypt, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have declared that the ongoing Israeli occupation is the primary cause of regional instability. During a meeting in Istanbul, the group called for an immediate two-state solution to address growing global concerns regarding injustice. They officially backed the establishment of a Palestinian state based on 1967 borders, with East Jerusalem serving as its capital.
amharic: የግብፅ፣ የቱርክ፣ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና የፓኪስታን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች የእስራኤል ወረራ በክልሉ ላለው አለመረጋጋት ዋና ምክንያት እንደሆነ ገለጹ። በኢስታንቡል ባደረጉት ስብሰባ፣ ሚኒስትሮቹ አለም አቀፍ የፍትህ መጓደል ስሜትን ለመቅረፍ የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄ በአስቸኳይ እንዲተገበር ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌምን ዋና ከተማዋ ያደረገች የፍልስጤም መንግስት በ1967 ድንበር መሰረት እንዲቋቋም ያላቸውን ድጋፍ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Gibxii, Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan, weerarri Israa'eel naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuuf sababa guddaa ta'uu ibsan. Istanbulitti walgahii taasisaniin, haqa dhabuun addunyaarratti babal'achaa jiru furuuf, biyyoonni lameen (Israa'eel fi Philaasexiin) walaba ta'anii akka jiraatan furmaata hatattamaa akka barbaadamu gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, daangaa bara 1967 irratti hundaa'uun fi magaalaan guddoon ishees Yerusaalem bahaa taatee, biyyi Philaasexiin akka hundaa'u deggarsa qaban mirkaneessaniiru.

title: South Africa: Durban mayoral candidate says he would welcome Netanyahu despite ICC warrant
english: Haniff Hoosen, the Democratic Alliance's mayoral candidate for Durban, has sparked controversy by stating he would welcome Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu if it benefited the city. Despite an existing ICC arrest warrant for Netanyahu regarding alleged war crimes, Hoosen insists his priority is urban improvement rather than international politics. This stance stands in direct opposition to South Africa's official diplomatic push for accountability concerning the conflict in Gaza.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካው የደርባን ከተማ ከንቲባ ዕጩ ሃኒፍ ሁሴን፣ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለከተማዋ ጥቅም የሚጠቅም ጉብኝት ካደረጉ በደስታ እንደሚቀበሏቸው በመግለጻቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት አስነስተዋል። ኔታንያሁ በዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በጦር ወንጀል የተከሰሱ ቢሆኑም፣ እጩው ግን ትኩረታቸው የከተማዋን ችግሮች መፍታት እንጂ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖለቲካ እንዳልሆነ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አቋም ደቡብ አፍሪካ ጋዛ ውስጥ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በተመለከተ ዓለም አቀፍ ተጠያቂነትን ለማስፈን ከምትከተለው አቋም ጋር የሚቃረን ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni magaalaa Durban, Haniff Hoosen, yoo fayidaa magaalaatiif ta'e Ministirri Mummee Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu akka dhufan kan affeeran ta'uu ibsuun isaanii mormii cimaa kaaseera. Netanyahu yakka waraanaatiin himatamanii ajajni qabamuu isaanii kan ba'e ta'us, Hoosen xiyyeeffannoon isaa rakkoolee magaalaa furuu malee siyaasa idil-addunyaa akka hin taane dubbateera. Yaanni isaa kun, mootummaan Afriikaa Kibbaa waraana Gaazaarratti hirmaannaa Israa'el irratti gaafatama barbaaduuf qabdu kan mormuudha.

title: Turkey has no plans to fight Houthis under Saudi pact, minister says
english: Turkish Defence Minister Yasar Guler stated that Turkey does not intend to participate in combat against Houthi rebels as part of its new defence agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. Instead, the country plans to focus on defensive deterrence, similar to its military role in Qatar. Any future military assistance will be carefully reviewed and require formal approval from the Turkish parliament.
amharic: የቱርክ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ያሳር ጉለር እንደገለጹት፣ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር በተፈረመው የመከላከያ ስምምነት መሰረት ቱርክ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ እቅድ የላትም። ይልቁንም ሀገሪቱ በኳታር እንደምታደርገው ሁሉ በዋናነት የመከላከያ አቅምን በማጠናከር ላይ ትኩረት እንደምታደርግ አስታውቀዋል። ማንኛውም የወደፊት ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ጥያቄ በጥንቃቄ ተገምግሞ የቱርክ ፓርላማ ይሁንታ ካገኘ በኋላ ብቻ የሚወሰን ይሆናል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Turkii Yaasar Guler akka jedhanitti, Turkii waliigaltee ittisaa Sa’udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan waliin mallatteessiteen walqabatee garee Huutii wajjin waraana keessatti hirmaachuuf karoora hin qabu. Kanaa mannaa, Turkii akka qataritti akkaataa ittisaa fi tasgabbii eegsisuu irratti qofa xiyyeeffatti. Gargaarsi waraanaa yoo jiraate, qorannoo booda fi hayyama mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Turkii argate qofa kan raawwatamu ta’a.

title: Aston Villa vs Manchester City: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups
english: Manchester City will travel to Villa Park this Saturday to face Aston Villa in an English Premier League match. Despite facing recent financial controversy, City enters the game undefeated in their first seven matches and aims to extend their lead at the top of the table. Meanwhile, manager Enzo Maresca is focused on helping star player Phil Foden maintain his recently rediscovered scoring form.
amharic: ማንችስተር ሲቲ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በአስቶን ቪላ ሜዳ ላይ ከቪላ ጋር በሚያደርጉት የእንግሊዝ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ጨዋታ ይገናኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን ክለቡ በፋይናንሺያል ህግ ጥሰት ክስ ውስጥ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን ባደረጓቸው ሰባት ጨዋታዎች ሁሉንም በማሸነፍ በሊጉ አናት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል። አሰልጣኝ ኤንዞ ማሬስካ በበኩላቸው በቅርቡ ጎል ማስቆጠር የጀመረውን ኮከብ ተጫዋች ፊል ፎደንን ብቃት ለማስቀጠል ትኩረት ሰጥተው እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Manchester City Dilbata dhufu kana tapha English Premier League irratti Aston Villa waliin dirree Villa Park irratti kan taphatan ta'a. Man City rakkoo seera maallaqaa isaanii ilaalchisee komiin irratti ka'us, hanga amma taphoota torba taphatan hunda injifachuun sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu. Gama biraatiin, leenjisaan Manchester City Enzo Maresca, taphataa isaanii Phil Foden kan yeroo dheeraa booda goolii galchuu eegale akka gaariitti itti fufuuf gargaarsa gochaa jiru.

title: Israel locks down occupied West Bank after Hebron shooting
english: Israel has placed the occupied West Bank under lockdown following a shooting incident near Hebron that resulted in the deaths of two Israeli soldiers. In response, Israeli military forces have conducted raids on Palestinian homes and detained several local residents. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has warned that the government may launch a major military operation in the region, describing it as potentially the largest since 1967.
amharic: በሄብሮን አቅራቢያ ሁለት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጥይት ተመትተው መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ እስራኤል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ላይ የእንቅስቃሴ ገደብ ጥላለች። ለዚህም ምላሽ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በፍልስጤማውያን መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ወረራ በማካሄድ በርካታ ነዋሪዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ከ1967 ወዲህ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ሊያካሂዱ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriiraa fi dhukaasa Heebroonitti raawwatamee fi loltoota Israa'el lama ajjeese booda, Israa'el guutuu naannoo weeraraa West Bank irratti uggura cimaa gooteetti. Kana hordofee, waraanni Israa'el mana jireenyaa Falasxiinotaa weeraruun namoota hedduu hidheetti. Ministirri Muummee Benyaamiin Netaanyaahuu, waraanni kun duula waraanaa kanaan dura bara 1967 irraa eegalee hin mul'anne hammaataa ta'e tokko jalqabsiisuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Former FBI officials charged in connection with Hunter Biden laptop probe
english: Two former FBI officials, Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides, have been charged with lying to Congress regarding their involvement in the 2020 investigation of Hunter Biden’s laptop. Prosecutors claim the pair falsely testified that their intelligence unit played no role in the case, despite internal communications suggesting otherwise. The officials' legal teams argue these charges are politically motivated to influence the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ሁለት የቀድሞ የኤፍቢአይ (FBI) ባለስልጣናት በሃንተር ባይደን ላፕቶፕ ምርመራ ላይ ለኮንግረስ ውሸት ተናግረዋል በሚል ክስ ቀረበባቸው። አቃቤ ህጎቹ ሁለቱ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራውን በተመለከተ የውሸት መረጃ ሰጥተዋል ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ተከሳሾቹ ግን ክሱ የመጪውን ምርጫ ውጤት ለመቀየር ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ የፖለቲካ ሴራ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni damee qorannoo yakka biyyoolessa (FBI) durii lama, Nikki Floris fi Bradley Benavides, qorannoo laaptooppii ilma Joo Baayiden, Hantar Baayiden irratti soba dubbataniiru jedhamanii himataman. Abbaan alangaa akka himatutti, namoonni kunneen hojii isaanii keessatti laaptooppicha irratti hirmaannaa akka hin qabne sobaan ragaa bahaniiru. Gamtaan abukaattootaa garuu himannaan kun filannoo dhufu irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf kaayyoo siyaasaa qaba jechuun morman.

title: Trump administration sues to block possible Democratic win in Alaska
english: The U.S. Department of Justice has filed a lawsuit attempting to block the certification of Alaska's Senate election results. The administration claims that an independent candidate sharing a name with the Republican incumbent could confuse voters and undermine the election's integrity. President Trump admitted to ordering the legal action, sparking concerns that the government is interfering in the midterm elections to favor Republican candidates.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር የአላስካን የሴኔት ምርጫ ውጤት ማረጋገጫን ለማገድ ክስ መስርቷል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር እንደሚለው፣ ከሪፐብሊካኑ ሴናተር ጋር ተመሳሳይ ስም ያለው ገለልተኛ እጩ መወዳደር መራጮችን ግራ በማጋባት የምርጫውን ታማኝነት ሊያዛባ ይችላል። ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ይህንን የህግ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ያዘዙት እሳቸው መሆናቸውን በመግለጻቸው፣ አስተዳደሩ በምርጫው ሂደት ላይ ጣልቃ እየገባ ነው የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Ministeerri Haqaa Ameerikaa bu'aa filannoo seeneetii Alaska akka hin raggaasifamne dhorkuuf himata baneera. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, maqaan kaadhimamaa walabaa tokkoo kan senataroota riippaabilikaanotaa wajjin walfakkaatu kun filattoota burjaajessuudhaan amanamummaa filannoo sanaa miidhuu danda'a. Pirezidaanti Traamp tarkaanfii seeraa kana akka isaan ajajan erga mirkaneeffatanii booda, mootummaan filannoo giddu galeessaatti gartuu isaanii gargaaruuf harka gadi jedhuu isaa shakkii guddaan uumameera.

title: Many feared trapped after multistorey building collapses in Kenya
english: A multistorey building under construction collapsed in Nairobi’s Eastleigh neighborhood, leaving many people trapped beneath the rubble. Although the building lacked an occupancy permit, shops were already operating on the ground floor while construction continued above. Emergency teams are working through the debris, but rescue efforts are being complicated by concerns regarding structural stability and the slow arrival of heavy machinery.
amharic: በናይሮቢ ኢስትሌይ ሰፈር እየተገነባ የነበረ ባለ ብዙ ፎቅ ህንጻ በመፍረሱ በርካታ ሰዎች ፍርስራሹ ስር ተቀብረዋል ተብሎ ይፈራል። ህንጻው የመኖሪያ ወይም የንግድ ፈቃድ ባይኖረውም፣ ግንባታው ሳይጠናቀቅ የታችኛው ፎቅ ለንግድ አገልግሎት እየዋለ ነበር። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ፍርስራሹን በመማስ ህይወት ለማትረፍ ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ የህንጻው መፍረስ ስጋት እና የከባድ ማሽኖች መዘግየት ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Nairobi, naannoo Eastleigh jedhamu keessatti ijaarsi gamoo baay'ee ol dheeratuu tokko diigamee, namoonni hedduun sababa kanaatiin ijaarsa sana jala akka jiran sodaatameera. Gamoon kun eeyyama gabaa ykn mana jireenyaa kan hin qabne ta'us, ijaarsi isaa utuu hin xumuramin gadii isaa daldalaaf banamee ture. Gareen fayyisaa namoota jiran baasuuf qarqara irratti argamanis, balaan biroo uumamuu danda'uufi qophiin gahaa dhabamuun isaanii hojii fayyinsaa sana ulfaata taasiseera.

title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
english: A deadly shooting spree in the suburbs of Paris has left one person dead and five others injured, including a child. Authorities have arrested the suspect and are treating the incident as a terrorist attack involving potential racial or religious bias. The gunman reportedly targeted random individuals across several locations before being captured by police.
amharic: በፓሪስ ዳርቻዎች በተፈጸመ ገዳይ የተኩስ ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል፤ ከተጎጂዎች መካከል ህፃን ልጅም ትገኝበታለች። ባለሥልጣናት ተጠርጣሪውን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉት ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱን በዘር ወይም በሃይማኖት ጥላቻ የተነሳ የተፈጸመ የሽብር ጥቃት እንደሆነ እየመረመሩት ይገኛል። ጥቃት አድራሹ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በዘፈቀደ ተኩስ ከፍቶ እንደነበር ተገልጿል።
oromo: Naannoo magaalaa Paarisitti dhukaasa haleellaa namoota irratti banameen namni tokko yoo du'u, shan immoo madaa'aniiru. Qaamoleen nageenyaa shakkamicha to'annaa jala oolchanii jiran; haleellaan kunis akka yakka shororkeessummaa fi jibba sanyummaa ykn amantii irratti hundaa'eetti qoratamaa jira. Namichi hidhate kun iddoowwan garagaraatti namoota irratti dhukaasa banuun booda poolisiidhaan qabameera.

title: Six shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
english: Gunmen launched a deadly attack on a church funeral in the Jordanian village of Hmoud, resulting in the deaths of six people and injuring 28 others. The assailants arrived by car and opened fire on mourners before escaping the scene. King Abdullah II has condemned the violence as a terrorist act and vowed to hold those responsible accountable.
amharic: በዮርዳኖስ የህሙድ መንደር በሚገኝ ቤተክርስቲያን በተደረገ የቀብር ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ የታጠቁ ሰዎች በከፈቱት ጥቃት ስድስት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 28 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃት አድራሾቹ በመኪና በመምጣት በሰዎች ላይ ተኩስ ከፍተው በስፍራው ተሰወሩ። የዮርዳኖሱ ንጉሥ አብዱላህ ሁለተኛ ይህንን የሽብር ጥቃት አጥብቀው በማውገዝ አጥፊዎቹ በህግ ፊት እንደሚቀርቡ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: ዮርዳኖስ keessatti namoonni hidhatan bakka awwaalaatti namoota hedduu irratti dhukaasa bananiin namoonni ja'a yoo du'an, 28 immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleeltoonni kun konkolaataan dhufanii namoota gadda irra turan irratti dhukaasuun erga haleelanii booda bakkeedhaa bahaniiru. Mootiin biyyattii Abduullaah II, gocha kana gocha shororkeessummaa jechuun balaaleffataniiru akkasumas qaamni yakka kana raawwate seeraan akka gaafatamu ibsaniiru.

title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
english: The White House announced that First Lady Melania Trump has negotiated a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky to provide urgent humanitarian aid. This agreement aims to assist elderly residents facing severe shortages of food, water, and medical care after years of conflict. While the truce is scheduled to start on October 29, both Russian and Ukrainian officials have yet to officially confirm the arrangement.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ዋይት ሀውስ ቀዳማዊት እመቤት ሜላኒያ ትራምፕ በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር በምትገኘው የዩክሬን ከተማ ኦሌሽኪ አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ለማድረስ የሚያስችል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ማመቻቸታቸውን አስታውቋል። በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ለምግብ፣ ለውሃ እና ለህክምና እጦት የተጋለጡ የከተማዋን ነዋሪዎች ለመርዳት የተደረገው ይህ ስምምነት በጥቅምት 29 ቀን ተግባራዊ ይሆናል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይሁን እንጂ የሩሲያ እና የዩክሬን መንግስታት ስለ ስምምነቱ እስካሁን ይፋዊ አስተያየት አልሰጡም።
oromo: Mana maree Amerika (White House) akka ibsetti, jalqabaa ergaa (First Lady) Melania Trump magaalaan Yukreyn kan harka Raashiyaa jirtu Oleshki keessatti gargaarsa namoomaa ariifachiisaa dhaqqabsiisuuf walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa taasiseetti. Walii galtichi kun jiraattota magaalaatii kanneen waraanan miidhamanii fi nyaata, bishaan akkasumas qorichaa dhabanii jiran gargaaruuf kan karoorfame dha. Walii galtichi kun Onkoloolessa 29 irraa eegalee kan hojii irra oolu ta'us, mootummoonni Raashiyaa fi Yukreyn ammaaf gama isaaniitiin ibsa tokkollee hin kennine.

title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
english: French football authorities have rescheduled the PSG versus Lyon match from Sunday to Monday due to concerns over upcoming public protests in Paris. Police requested the delay to ensure security as the city prepares for large-scale demonstrations regarding living costs and other social issues. This shift follows similar adjustments to other domestic league games as the region manages heightened security requirements.
amharic: የፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን እና የሊዮን የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታ በፓሪስ ከተማ ሊካሄድ ከታቀደው ሰፊ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞ ጋር በተያያዘ በአንድ ቀን ዘግይቷል። የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት እና ፖሊስ ለደህንነት ሲባል ጨዋታው ከእሁድ ወደ ሰኞ እንዲዛወር ወስነዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የኑሮ ውድነትን እና ሌሎች ማህበራዊ ጉዳዮችን በመቃወም በከተማዋ ሊደረጉ የታቀዱ ሰልፎችን ተከትሎ የደህንነት ስጋት በመፈጠሩ ነው።
oromo: Taphi kubbaa miilaa PSG fi Lyon gidduutti taasifamuuf ture, magaalaan Paaris guddina gatii fi gaaffilee hawaasummaa biroo irratti hundaa'ee hiriira gurguddaa waan qophooftuuf guyyaan isaa jijjiirameera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa Faransaay nageenya mirkaneessuuf jecha taphichi Dilbata irraa gara Wiixataatti akka darbu ajajaniiru. Jijjiirraan kun kan taasifame, magaalaan sun sagantaalee nageenyaa dabalataa barbaaduu ishee hordofee dha.

title: What to know as Brazil prepares for tense presidential run-off
english: Brazil is preparing for a highly anticipated presidential run-off election on October 25 between current President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro. Following a surprising first-round performance where Bolsonaro gained a slight lead, both candidates are intensifying their efforts to win over voters for the final decision. This election represents a significant moment for Latin American politics, as a victory for the conservative candidate could signal a major regional shift toward right-wing leadership.
amharic: ብራዚል በጥቅምት 25 በሚካሄደው የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር ላይ ለሚደረገው የለውጥ ትንቅንቅ በዝግጅት ላይ ትገኛለች። አሁን ያሉት ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና የቀኝ ዘመም አራማጁ ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በድጋሚ ለድምጽ ይቀርባሉ። በመጀመሪያው ዙር ቦልሶናሮ ባሳዩት አመርቂ ውጤት ምርጫው ተጠባቂነቱ ከፍተኛ ሆኗል፤ የዚህ ምርጫ ውጤት ብራዚል ወደ ቀኝ ዘመም የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ እንደምትዞር ወይም ሉላ ስልጣናቸውን እንደሚይዙ የሚወስን በመሆኑ ቀጠናዊ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Brazil qophii xumuraa filannoo pirezidaantummaa kan Onkoloolessa 25 gaggeeffamuuf qophaa'aa jirti; filannoo kana irratti pirezidaantii amma aangoorra jiran Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva fi senaterri mirga-jabeessa Flavio Bolsonaro wal dorgomu. Filannoo kanaan dura gaggeeffame irratti Bolsonaro injifannoo xiqqoo argachuun isaa dorgommiin kun akka cimaa deemu taasiseera. Filannoon kun biyyattii qofa osoo hin taane, gara fuulduraatti gara siyaasa mirga-jabeessotaatti kan ceetu ta'uu fi dhiibbaa naannoo irratti qabuun barbaachisaa ta'a.

title: Conte dismisses reports of Man United takeover with Carrick’s job uncertain
english: Antonio Conte has officially denied rumors that he is in advanced talks to replace Michael Carrick as the manager of Manchester United. The Italian coach stated that claims about him demanding full control or specific financial terms are completely false. Conte clarified that he is currently taking a break following his time at Napoli and will only consider new job opportunities when the right conditions are met.
amharic: አንቶኒዮ ኮንቴ በማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ የዋና አሰልጣኝነት ቦታ ለመተካት ድርድር ላይ እንደሆኑ የሚነገረውን ወሬ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የጣሊያን አሰልጣኙ በክለቡ ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዲኖራቸው እንደጠየቁና የተጋነኑ የገንዘብ ጥቅማ ጥቅሞችን እንደፈለጉ የሚናፈሰው ወሬ ከእውነት የራቀ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ናፖሊን ከለቀቁ በኋላ በአሁኑ ወቅት እረፍት ላይ እንደሆኑና ትክክለኛ ሁኔታዎች ሲሟሉ ብቻ ወደ ስራ እንደሚመለሱም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: አንቶኒዮ ኮንቴ የክለብ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ማይክል ካሪክን ለመተካት ድርድር ላይ መሆናቸውን የሚገልጸውን መረጃ አስተባብለዋል። ጣሊያናዊው አሰልጣኝ በክለቡ ላይ ሙሉ ስልጣን ወይም ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ክፍያ ጠይቀዋል ተብሎ የሚናፈሰው ወሬ መሰረት የሌለው መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ናፖሊን ለቀቁ በኋላ በአሁኑ ወቅት እረፍት ላይ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ተገቢው ሁኔታ ሲሟላ ብቻ ወደ ስራ እንደሚመለሱ ተናግረዋል።

title: Mississippi releases video of 1-year-old’s fatal police shooting
english: Mississippi officials have released body camera footage showing the fatal police shooting of a one-year-old child named Kohen Wiley. The incident occurred while a police officer was responding to a shoplifting report and fired shots into a moving vehicle. Although authorities determined the officer did not commit a crime, the victim's family maintains that the use of lethal force was unnecessary and wrong.
amharic: የሚሲሲፒ ባለስልጣናት ኮሄን ዋይሊ የተባለ የአንድ አመት ህጻን በፖሊስ በጥይት ተመትቶ መሞቱን የሚያሳይ የሰውነት ካሜራ ምስል ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተፈጠረው አንድ የፖሊስ መኮንን በሱቅ ስርቆት ጥሪ ምክንያት በተንቀሳቃሽ መኪና ላይ ጥይት በተኮሰበት ወቅት ነው። ባለስልጣናቱ መኮንኑ ምንም አይነት ወንጀል እንዳልፈፀመ ቢወስኑም፣ የህጻኑ ቤተሰብ ግን የፖሊሱ እርምጃ አላስፈላጊ እና ተገቢ ያልሆነ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Mississippi viidiyoofi suuraa qaamaa isaanii irratti qabatan (bodycam) kan agarsiisu, poolisiin tokko ijoollee waggaa tokko kan ta'e Kohen Wiley rasaasaan rukutee ajjeesuu isaati. Taphni kun kan ta'e poolisiin sun gabaasa hattootaa hordofee osoo jiru konkolaataa socho'aa jiru keessatti dhukaasa banuun ture. Abbootiin taayitaa poolisichi yakka hin raawwanne jedhanii murteessan illee, maatiin ijoollee sanaa tarkaanfiin poolisichaa sirrii fi barbaachisaa kan hin turre jedhanii mormu.

title: Finland nearing opening of world’s first permanent nuclear waste repository
english: Finland has officially issued an operating license for Onkalo, the world’s first permanent underground repository for spent nuclear fuel. Located in the western part of the country, this facility is designed to safely store radioactive waste in copper canisters buried deep within the bedrock for at least 100,000 years. While final testing is still required before the site begins receiving waste, this development marks a historic milestone in managing long-term nuclear byproduct disposal.
amharic: ፊንላንድ ለአለም የመጀመሪያው የኑክሌር ቆሻሻ ማስወገጃ ቦታ የሆነውን ኦንካሎ የተባለውን ተቋም እንዲሠራ ፈቃድ ሰጥታለች። በሀገሪቱ ምዕራባዊ ክፍል የሚገኘው ይህ ማከማቻ፣ የኑክሌር ቆሻሻን በመዳብ በተሠሩ እቃዎች ውስጥ በማሸግ ከመሬት በታች ለ100,000 ዓመታት ያህል በደህና ለማስቀመጥ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ጣቢያው ስራ ከመጀመሩ በፊት የመጨረሻ ፍተሻዎች ቢቀሩትም፣ ይህ እርምጃ የኑክሌር ቆሻሻን በዘላቂነት ለማስተዳደር በተደረገው ጥረት ታሪካዊ ምዕራፍ ሆኗል።
oromo: Fiinlaandiin iddoo kuusaa xuraa'ina niukilaraa (nuclear waste) kan jalqabaa addunyaa irraa, 'Onkalo' jedhamuuf hayyama hojii kenniteetti. Kutaalee lixaa biyyattii keessatti kan argamu kun, xuraa'ina niukilaraa qodaa naasaa irraa tolfame keessatti haamee lafa keessatti waggaa 100,000 ol akka turuuf qophaayeera. Iddoon kun hojii jalqabuun dura qorannoon dhumaa kan hafe yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii seena qabeessa xuraa'ina niukilaraa itti fufiinsaan bulchuuf fudhatameedha.

title: Dembele to miss Ballon d’Or event as PSG game moved amid protests in France
english: The French football league has rescheduled the Paris Saint-Germain match against Lyon to Monday due to concerns over violent protests in Paris. This change prevents Ousmane Dembele and several of his PSG teammates from attending the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London. Authorities have implemented strict security measures across France to manage the expected unrest over the weekend.
amharic: በፓሪስ በሚካሄዱ የሁከት ተቃውሞዎች ምክንያት የፈረንሳይ እግር ኳስ ሊግ የፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን እና የሊዮን ጨዋታን ወደ ሰኞ አስተላልፏል። ይህ የጊዜ ለውጥ ኦስማን ደምቤሌ እና ሌሎች የቡድን አጋሮቹ ለንደን ውስጥ በሚካሄደው የባሎንዶር ሽልማት ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ እንዳይገኙ አድርጓቸዋል። የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ሊከሰት የሚችለውን ሁከት ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ጥበቃ እርምጃዎችን ወስደዋል።
oromo: Ajajoonni biyya Faransaay hiriira mormii biyyattii keessatti geggeeffamaa jiru hordofee, tapha gartuu Paariis Saint-Jeermeen fi Liyooyen gidduutti taasifamu gara guyyaa Dilbataatti dhiibuu murteessaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun Oosmaan Dembele fi taphattoonni Paariis biroo sirna badhaasaa 'Balon d'Or' kan Laandanitti geggeeffamu irratti akka hin argamne taasiseera. Mootummaan Faransaay, walitti bu'iinsa guyyoota dhufan irratti eeggamu to'achuuf nageenya biyyattii cimsee jira.

title: Jewish settlers destroy Shireen Abu Akleh memorial near Jenin
english: A group of armed Israeli settlers recently destroyed a memorial dedicated to the late Al Jazeera reporter Shireen Abu Akleh near the city of Jenin. The monument had been established by local officials to honor her life and work following her death in 2022. Abu Akleh was fatally shot by an Israeli soldier while she was covering a military operation in the region.
amharic: በቅርቡ ታጣቂ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በጀኒን ከተማ አቅራቢያ ለነበረችው የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ ሽሪን አቡ አቅሌ የተሰራውን መታሰቢያ አፍርሰዋል። የሀገር ውስጥ አስተዳደሩ ጋዜጠኛዋን ለማስታወስ ያቆሙት ይህ ሐውልት በ2022 በጀኒን በነበረ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት በእስራኤል ወታደር ከተገደለች በኋላ የተሰራ ነው። አቡ አቅሌ በወቅቱ የዜና ዘገባ ላይ እያለች ነበር በጥይት ተመታ ህይወቷ ያለፈው።
oromo: gareen qawwee hidhatan kan qubata Israa'el ta'an, bakka yaadannoo gaazexeessituu Al Jazeera kan turte Shireen Abuu Akleh, magaalaa Jenin biratti mancaasaniiru. Yaadannoon kun hojii fi jireenya ishee kabajuuf abbootii taayitaa naannichaan dhaabamee ture. Abuu Akleh bara 2022 yeroo duula waraanaa irratti gabaasa gochaa turte ajaja waraana Israa'eliniin ajjeefamte.

title: Netanyahu threatens sweeping military offensive in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced plans for a significant military campaign in the occupied West Bank. He described the potential operation as the largest of its kind since 1967. While the initiative is being prepared, Netanyahu emphasized that Israel will determine the most appropriate time to launch it.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ለማካሄድ ማቀዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የታቀደው ጥቃት ከ1967 ዓ.ም ወዲህ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚሆን ገልጸዋል። የእርምጃው ዝግጅቶች እየተከናወኑ ቢሆንም፣ ጥቃቱ የሚጀመርበትን ጊዜ እስራኤል እንደምትወስን አሳውቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Neetaanyaahoon naannoo Weest Baank jedhamutti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeessuuf karoorachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Duulli kun bara 1967 irraa kaasee kan hin mul'anne hamma isaa kan guddatu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Qophiin isaa jalqabamee jiraatus, yeroon duulichi itti eegalu tarkaanfii Israa'el of harkaa qabdu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: How Israel’s election is further excluding Palestinian citizens from politics
english: Sami Abu Shehadeh, a prominent Palestinian leader, was forced to withdraw from the Israeli parliamentary race after facing intense pressure from the Supreme Court. The court questioned his political loyalties and views, ultimately signaling that it would uphold his disqualification despite clearing other candidates. This event highlights the growing difficulties and systemic marginalization Palestinian citizens face when attempting to participate in Israeli politics. It underscores a broader struggle for Palestinians trying to maintain their national identity within a state that frequently views their political expression with suspicion.
amharic: ታዋቂው የፍልስጤም መሪ ሳሚ አቡ ሻሀዴ በጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በደረሰባቸው ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት ከእስራኤል ምርጫ እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የእሳቸውን የፖለቲካ አቋም እና ታማኝነት በመጠየቅ፣ ሌሎች እጩዎችን ቢፈቅድም የእሳቸውን እጩነት ውድቅ ለማድረግ ማቀዱን ገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት የፍልስጤም ዜጎች በእስራኤል ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ለመሳተፍ ሲሞክሩ የሚገጥማቸውን ከፍተኛ ተግዳሮት እና መገለል ያሳያል። ይህም የፍልስጤም ዜጎች በፖለቲካዊ አገላለጻቸው ላይ በሚያደርጉት ጥረት እና በሀገሪቱ ባለው የጥርጣሬ አስተሳሰብ መካከል ያለውን የረዥም ጊዜ ትግል ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Palastiin Sami Abu Shehadeh jedhaman dhiibbaa mana murtii olaanaa Israa'el irra gaheen booda filannoo parlamaa keessaa akka bahan dirqisiifamaniiru. Mana murtichaa ilaalcha siyaasaa fi amanamummaa isaanii gaaffii keessa galchuudhaan, dorgomtoota biroo hayyamus, isaanii garuu akka dhaabatan fedha akka hin qabne ibseera. Taateen kun lammiileen Palastiin siyaasa Israa'el keessatti hirmaachuuf yaalan gufuu fi tuffii guddaa akka mudatu argisiisa. Kunis lammiileen Palastiin eenyummaa isaanii kabachiisuuf jecha sirna mootummaa keessatti qabsoo guddaa taasisuu akka qaban kan ibsuudha.

title: Hundreds to risk arrest at 'mass actions' targeting US embassies over Palestine Action ban
english: Hundreds of protesters plan to gather outside US diplomatic sites in London and Edinburgh on October 31 to demonstrate against the government's ban on the activist group Palestine Action. Participants intend to risk potential arrest under terrorism laws by publicly expressing their support for the group. This mass action is scheduled just before the Supreme Court reviews the legality of the ban, which has already led to thousands of arrests across the UK.
amharic: በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች በፓለስታይን አክሽን ቡድን ላይ የተጣለውን እገዳ በመቃወም ጥቅምት 31 ቀን በለንደን እና በኤዲንበርግ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ተቋማት ፊት ለፊት ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ ለማድረግ አቅደዋል። ተሳታፊዎቹ ለቡድኑ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በይፋ በመግለጽ በአሸባሪነት ህግ መሰረት ለእስር ለመዳረግ ተዘጋጅተዋል። ይህ ሰፊ ተቃውሞ የጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የእገዳውን ህጋዊነት ከመመርመሩ ጥቂት ቀናት በፊት የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በዚሁ ምክንያት ለእስር ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman garee 'Palestine Action' irratti dhorkaan kaa'ame mormuuf, guyyaa Onkoloolessa 31 bakkeewwan dippilomaasii Amerikaa kan London fi Edinburghitti hiriira bahuuf karoorfataniiru. Hiriirtoonni kun garee kanaaf deggarsa qaban ifatti ibsuun seera shororkeessummaa jalatti hidhamuuf qophiidha. Hiriirri kun Mana Murtii Olaanaa irratti dhorkaan kun seera qabeessa ta'uu isaa qorachuun dura kan gaggeeffamu yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti biyyattii keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman sababa kanaan hidhamaniru.

title: Journalist Heidi Levine recounts Israeli settler attack and Palestinians’ daily fear
english: Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine was physically assaulted by Israeli settlers, who knocked her down, kicked her, and struck her with sticks during a violent encounter. Following her recovery, Levine expressed that the traumatic experience helped her empathize with the daily fears and violence faced by Palestinians. Despite the ordeal, she remains dedicated to her journalistic work to shed light on these ongoing issues.
amharic: የዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጠኛ ሃይዲ ሌቪን በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች ጥቃት እንደደረሰባት ገልጻለች፣ ጥቃቱ በአካል እንድትጎዳ አድርጓታል። ከደረሰባት ህመም በኋላ፣ ሌቪን ይህ ክስተት ፍልስጤማውያን በየቀኑ የሚኖሩትን ፍርሃትና ጥቃት ለመረዳት እንደረዳት ተናግራለች። በደረሰባት ጉዳት ብትጎዳም፣ ሁኔታውን ለዓለም ለማድረስ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት እንደማትቀንስ አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Waashingitan Poost Hayidii Leeviin, qubattoota Israa'el irraa miidhaa qaamaa fi reebicha isheerratti raawwatameen miidhamuu ishee ibsiteetti. Leeviin miidhaa isheerra ga'e booda, muuxannoon kun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa fi sodaa palastaayinoonni keessa jiran hubachuuf akka ishee gargaare dubbatteetti. Miidhaan isheerra ga'e iyyuu, rakkoo kana addunyaaf ibsuuf hojii ishee itti fufuuf murteeffatteetti.

title: Five Israelis wounded and two suspected Palestinian attackers killed in West Bank shooting
english: Two suspected Palestinian gunmen were killed by Israeli security forces after wounding five Israelis during a shooting at a checkpoint near Hebron in the West Bank. Following the incident, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered a military lockdown of the region, and authorities recovered significant ammunition from the attackers' vehicle. This violent event takes place amid heightened regional tensions and just days before Israel's scheduled general election.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ሄብሮን ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የፍተሻ ጣቢያ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አምስት እስራኤላውያን ቆስለዋል፣ ሁለት የፍልስጤም ተጠርጣሪዎችም በእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ተገድለዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለክልሉ አጠቃላይ የእንቅስቃሴ ገደብ እንዲጣል ትእዛዝ የሰጡ ሲሆን፣ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችም በተጠርጣሪዎቹ መኪና ውስጥ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ጥይት አግኝተዋል። ይህ ግጭት የተከሰተው በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት ከፍተኛ በሆነበት እና የእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ሊካሄድ ጥቂት ቀናት ብቻ በቀሩበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Naannoo West Bank magaalaa Hebronitti argamutti, namoonni lama kanneen hidhattoota Falasxiin ta'an shakkaman, waraana Israa'el irratti dhukaasa bananii booda humnoota nageenyaatiin ajjeefamaniiru; dhukaasa kanaanis Israa'eloonni shan madaa'aniiru. Muummichi Ministaraa Benyaamin Neetanyaahu naannichatti labsii daangaa cufuu kan labsan yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni kunneen konkolaataa isaanii keessatti rasaasa baay'ee qabachuu isaanii mootummaan beeksiseera. Rakkoon kun kan uumame waraqaan filannoo Israa'el dhihaachuu fi naannichatti walitti bu'iinsi cimaan jiraachuu isaa hordofee dha.

title: Cyprus police open investigation into financial affairs of Roman Abramovich
english: Cypriot authorities have launched an investigation into the financial activities of billionaire Roman Abramovich following allegations of tax evasion and document falsification. The inquiry follows reports from the BBC and other investigative journalists suggesting that the accounting firm Deloitte helped hide hundreds of millions of dollars in assets. While Abramovich’s legal team denies any wrongdoing, the police are now working to determine if criminal actions occurred through offshore companies.
amharic: የቆጵሮስ ፖሊስ የቢሊየነሩን የሮማን አብራሞቪች የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የቢቢሲ እና ሌሎች ጋዜጠኞች የሂሳብ አያያዝ ድርጅቱ ዲሎይት አብራሞቪች ሀብቱን እንዲደብቅ እና ግብር እንዲያሸሽ እንደረዳው ከዘገቡ በኋላ ነው። አብራሞቪች ምንም አይነት ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት እንዳልፈፀመ ቢክድም፣ ባለስልጣናት በውጭ ሀገራት በሚገኙ ኩባንያዎች በኩል የተፈፀሙ የወንጀል ድርጊቶች መኖራቸውን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Poolisiin Qopiroos qabeenyaa fi hojiiwwan faayinaansii biiliyeenera Rooman Abraamooviich irratti qorannoo jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame, dhaabbanni herregaa Deelooyit qabeenya Abraamooviich dhoksuu fi gibira irraa akka fagaatu gargaareera jedhamee gabaasoota BBC fi qorattoota biraatiin himannaan erga dhiyaatee booda. Abraamooviich himannaa kana kan haalu yoo ta'u, abbootiin taayitaa garuu dhaabbilee biyya alaa keessatti socho'an kanaan yakki raawwatamuu isaa mirkaneessuuf qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
english: Typhoon Champi has severely disrupted travel and public life in Taiwan, leading to hundreds of flight cancellations and the closure of schools, offices, and the stock exchange. The powerful storm has already caused one death and over 170 injuries, with many residents forced to evacuate their homes. While the storm is expected to pass the island without making direct landfall, it is still expected to dump extreme rainfall and bring dangerous winds across the region.
amharic: ኃይለኛው የቻምፒ ታይፎን የታይዋንን የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት በማስተጓጎል በብዙ መቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ እና ትምህርት ቤቶች፣ ቢሮዎች እና የአክሲዮን ገበያው እንዲዘጉ አድርጓል። አውሎ ነፋሱ እስካሁን የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ሲቀጥፍ ከ170 በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል፣ በርካታ ነዋሪዎችም ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። አውሎ ነፋሱ በቀጥታ ደሴቲቱን ባይመታም፣ ከፍተኛ ዝናብ እና አደገኛ ነፋስ እንደሚያስከትል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Champi jedhamu kan Taiwan keessatti rakkoo guddaa uume yoo ta'u, kunis balaliiwwan hedduu akka haaqamaniifi manneen barnootaa, waajjiraaleefi gabaan aksiyoonaa akka cufaman taasiseera. Obomboleettiin cimaan kun lubbuu nama tokkoo galaafatee, namoota 171 ol irratti miidhaa geessiseera, akkasumas namoonni kuma tokko ol qe'ee isaaniirraa godaananiiru. Obomboleettiin kun biyyattii kallattiin rukuta jedhamee kan hin eegamne ta'us, rooba cimaafi bubbee baay'ee geessisuun isaa ni tilmaamama.

title: New electronics reach Iran, but prices soar as gov’t fees, US sanctions hit
english: Despite international sanctions and restricted trade routes, the latest electronic devices are still reaching consumers in Iran. However, these goods are arriving through complicated smuggling networks, which significantly inflates the cost for local buyers. Consequently, while technology remains available, the combined impact of government fees and trade barriers makes them unaffordable for many Iranians.
amharic: በአለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች እና በተገደበ የንግድ መስመሮች ምክንያት፣ አዳዲስ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሳሪያዎች ወደ ኢራን ቢገቡም በከፍተኛ ዋጋ እየተሸጡ ነው። እነዚህ እቃዎች ወደ ሀገር ውስጥ የሚገቡት በተወሳሰቡ የኮንትሮባንድ መንገዶች አማካኝነት በመሆኑ ለገዢዎች ከፍተኛ ወጪ ያስከትላል። በውጤቱም፣ ቴክኖሎጂው በገበያ ላይ ቢገኝም፣ በመንግስት ቀረጥ እና በንግድ እገዳዎች የተነሳ ለብዙ ኢራናውያን የመግዛት አቅም ከባድ ሆኗል።
oromo: Maallaqa biyyoota alaa fi daangaa daldalaan walqabatee rakkoon jiraatus, meeshaaleen elektirooniksii haaraa Iran keessatti argamuun isaanii itti fufeera. Haa ta'u malee, meeshaaleen kun gara biyyatti kan galan karaa seeraan alaa fi xaxamaa ta'een waan ta'eef, gatiin isaanii baay'ee qaaliidha. Bu'aa kanaatiin, teknolojichi gabaa keessatti kan argamu ta'us, gibira mootummaa fi gufuu daldalaa irraa kan ka'e namoonni hedduun bitachuu hin danda'an.

title: Serbia’s snap election: What’s at stake and can students unseat Vucic?
english: Serbia is holding a snap parliamentary election on October 25 that serves as a critical test for President Aleksandar Vucic’s long-standing leadership. The vote follows a nationwide protest movement led by students, sparked by public outrage over a deadly train station collapse in 2024. A new student-backed political group is now challenging the ruling party, focusing their campaign on fighting corruption and strengthening government accountability.
amharic: ሰርቢያ በጥቅምት 25 ቀን በሚካሄድ ቀደም ብሎ በተጠራ ፓርላማዊ ምርጫ ወሳኝ ምዕራፍ ላይ ትገኛለች። ምርጫው ለፕሬዚዳንት አሌክሳንደር ቩቺች የረጅም ጊዜ ስልጣን ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በ2024 በባቡር ጣቢያ የደረሰውን አሳዛኝ አደጋ ተከትሎ በተማሪዎች የተጀመረው ተቃውሞ ውጤት ነው። አሁን በአዲስ የተቋቋመው የተማሪዎች ቡድን ሙስናን በመዋጋት እና የመንግስትን ተጠያቂነት በማስፈን ገዥውን ፓርቲ ለመገዳደር እየሞከረ ነው።
oromo: Serbiyaan filannoo paarlaamaa hatattamaa sadaasa 25 gaggeessuuf qophiirra jirti; kunis dursaa Aleksaandar Vuuchichiif qormaata guddaa ta'eera. Filannoon kun sochii mormii barattootaan durfamuufi balaa gaaraa sana irratti mudateen booda dhalateen wal qabata. Gareen barattootaa haaraan kunis, malaammaltummaa irratti xiyyeeffachuufi itti gaafatamummaa mootummaa cimsuun paartii aangoo irra jiru dura dhaabbachaa jira.

title: NBA’s Irving praises Al-Shaair’s ‘selfless act’ after Hind Rajab fine paid
english: NBA star Kyrie Irving recently paid an NFL fine of nearly $12,000 imposed on football player Azeez Al-Shaair. Al-Shaair was penalized for displaying the name of Hind Rajab, a Palestinian child killed in Gaza, during a game. Irving described the gesture as a selfless act of solidarity and emphasized the importance of speaking out for those who have lost their lives in the conflict.
amharic: የኤንቢኤ ኮከብ ካይሪ ኢርቪንግ በቅርቡ የአሜሪካ እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች ለሆነው አዚዝ አል-ሻኢር የተጣለበትን የ12,000 ዶላር ቅጣት ከፍሏል። አል-ሻኢር የተቀጣው በጋዛ በጦርነት ለተገደለችው ህጻን ሂንድ ራጃብ ስም በመታሰቢያነት በመጠቀሙ ነው። ኢርቪንግ ይህንን ድርጊት የነጻነት እና የአብሮነት መግለጫ በማለት በማድነቅ፣ በጦርነቱ ህይወታቸውን ላጡ ንጹሃን ድምጽ መሆን አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Leeyyuun taphataa kubbaa sagalee (NBA) Kyrie Irving, adabbii maallaqa dolaara 12,000 ol ta'u kan taphataa kubbaa miillaa Azeez Al-Shaair irra ga'e kaffaleera. Al-Shaair kan adabame maqaa mucayyoo Falasxiin Hind Rajab jedhamtuu fi waraana Gaazaa keessatti ajjeefamte qoma isaa irratti barreessuun isaa fi. Irving gocha kana akka gocha tokkummaa fi of-kenninsaatti ilaaluun, namoota waraana kanaan miidhamanif sagalee ta'uun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: What role does the military play in Israeli schools?
english: The Israeli military plays a significant role in the daily lives of teenagers by integrating itself directly into the school system. Educational environments are used to prepare students for their future service in the armed forces. This ongoing influence shapes the experiences and perspectives of young people long before they officially enlist.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ በመሳተፍ የተማሪዎችን የዕለት ተዕለት ሕይወት ይቀርጻል። በትምህርት ተቋማት ውስጥ የሚሰጠው ስልጠና ወጣቶችን ለወደፊት ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ለማዘጋጀት ታስቦ የሚከናወን ነው። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው ተጽዕኖ ወጣቶች በይፋ ከመመልመላቸው በፊትም እንኳን ወታደራዊ አመለካከትን እንዲላበሱ ያደርጋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el mana barnootaa keessatti hirmaannaa cimaa qabaachuun jireenya dargaggootaa irratti dhiibbaa uuma. Manneen barnootaa barattoota gara fuulduraatti tajaajila waraanaaf akka qophaa'an gargaaruuf gosa barnootaa adda addaa fayyadamu. Dhiibbaan kun dargaggoonni osoo seeraan waraana hin seenin dura ilaalcha waraanaa akka horatan taasisa.

title: Pulaku: The two faces of Nigeria’s vigilantes
english: In Nigeria's Adamawa State, a Fulani-led vigilante group known as Pulaku is credited with fighting kidnapping, yet it faces serious accusations of torture and human rights abuses. While the group aims to improve security, victims have reported being abducted, intimidated, and held in dangerous conditions by these self-appointed law enforcers. This situation highlights the complex reality of relying on informal militias to maintain order, as their methods often blur the line between protection and criminal activity.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ አዳማዋ ግዛት የሚንቀሳቀሰው 'ፑላኩ' የተሰኘው የፉላኒ ታጣቂ ቡድን ወንጀለኞችን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ ሚና ቢኖረውም፣ አሰቃቂ ድርጊቶችን እና የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን በመፈጸም ይከሰሳል። ቡድኑ የጸጥታ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት የሚንቀሳቀስ ቢሆንም፣ በቡድኑ አባላት ስለሚፈጸሙ እገታዎችና ማስፈራሪያዎች የሚሰሙት ቅሬታዎች አሳሳቢ ሆነዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ ሕገወጥ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን በጸጥታ ስራ ውስጥ ማሳተፍ ለህብረተሰቡ ደህንነት ያለው ተጽዕኖ ምን ያህል አደገኛ እንደሆነ ያሳያል።
oromo: Naayijeeriya naannoo Adaamaawaatti gareen 'Pulaaku' jedhamu kan gosa Fulaanii irraa ijaarame, hattootaa fi buttoota ittisuuf kan gargaaru ta'us, dararaa fi miidhaa mirga namoomaa irratti raawwachuun himatama. Gareen kun nageenya buusuuf kan yaalu ta'us, namoonni ijoollee fi maatii isaanii irraa butamuun akkasumas sodaachifamuun isaanii gabaasameera. Haalli kun gareewwan ofiin ijaaran nageenya eegsisuuf fayyadamuu fi gochi isaanii kan seeraan ala ta'ee fi miidhaa kan geessisu ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: ‘Hereness’: What the forgotten history of Jewish anti-Zionism can teach us today
english: The British Green Party is facing political controversy after declaring Zionism to be racism, leading Prime Minister Andy Burnham to reject a coalition with them over concerns of antisemitism. While Zionism is often treated as synonymous with Jewish identity, many Jewish people—particularly younger generations—are increasingly identifying as anti-Zionist. This shift reflects a resurgence of interest in historical movements like the Jewish Labour Bund, which focused on Jewish cultural preservation within the countries where they lived rather than supporting a separate state.
amharic: የብሪታንያ አረንጓዴ ፓርቲ ጽዮናዊነት ዘረኝነት ነው በሚል መግለጫው የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ገብቷል፣ ይህም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ ቡርንሃም ፀረ-ሴማዊነትን በመጥቀስ ጥምረት እንዲያቋርጡ አድርጓቸዋል። ጽዮናዊነት ብዙ ጊዜ ከአይሁድ ማንነት ጋር ተመሳሳይ እንደሆነ ቢታይም፣ ብዙ አይሁዳውያን በተለይም ወጣቱ ትውልድ ራሳቸውን እንደ ፀረ-ጽዮናዊ መግለጽ ጀምረዋል። ይህ ለውጥ አይሁዳውያን በኖሩባቸው አገራት ባህላቸውን ለመጠበቅ ይንቀሳቀሱ የነበሩ እንደ የአይሁድ የሠራተኛ ቡንድ ያሉ ታሪካዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች እንደገና መነሳታቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin Magariisaa (Green Party) biyya Ingiliiz ibsa 'Siyooniizimiin sanyii jibbummaadha' jedhu baasuun isaa mormii siyaasaa uumeera; kunis muummee ministiraa Andy Burnham walitti dhufeenya isaan waliin qaban akka morman taasiseera. Siyooniizimiin yeroo baay'ee akka amantii Yihuudotaa waliin walfakkaatutti kan ilaalamu ta'us, Yihuudonni hedduun, keessattuu dhalootni dargaggootaa, amantii kana mormuuf murteeffataniiru. Jijjiiramni kun sochiiwwan seenaa darban kan akka 'Jewish Labour Bund' kan Yihuudonni biyya itti jiraatan keessatti aadaa isaanii eeggachuu irratti xiyyeeffatan akka irra deebi'anii yaadan isaan taasiseera.

title: Israel prepares full West Bank lockdown after Hebron shooting
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered a full lockdown of the West Bank following a shooting attack in Hebron that left five soldiers wounded. Two Palestinian attackers were killed during the incident, which prompted the Israeli military to seal off the area and conduct raids in nearby towns. Additionally, authorities have closed the Ibrahimi Mosque, sparking condemnation from Palestinian officials over restricted religious access.
amharic: በሄብሮን ከተማ አምስት እስራኤላዊ ወታደሮችን ያቆሰለ የተኩስ አደጋን ተከትሎ፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በመላው ዌስት ባንክ አጠቃላይ የመዝጊያ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። በወታደሮቹ ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘሩት ሁለቱ ፍልስጤማውያን በተኩስ ልውውጥ ተገድለዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር አካባቢውን በመዝጋት በበርካታ አካባቢዎች ወረራዎችን ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የኢብራሂሚ መስጊድንም በመዝጋቱ የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaanhu, qabsoo hidhattootaa Hebron keessatti waraana shan miidhe booda, guutummaa daangaa West Bank akka cufamu ajajan. Hidhannoo sana keessatti namoonni lama kanneen waraana irratti dhukaasan ajjeefamaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el naannichatti duula gaggeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, masgiida Ibraahimii cufuun isaanii ammoo mormii fi balaaleffannaa warra Falasxiim kaaseera.

title: How Trump, Israel and big tech are driving Latin America to the right
english: Flavio Bolsonaro is currently challenging incumbent president Lula da Silva in Brazil's upcoming runoff election, signaling a potential right-wing shift across Latin America. This movement is heavily supported by evangelical groups, international alliances with Israel, and young social media influencers who leverage controversial content to gain political momentum. These far-right figures are using digital platforms and strong ideological messaging to reshape the region's political landscape.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዝዳንታዊ እጩ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በምርጫው መወዳደራቸው በላቲን አሜሪካ የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲካዊ አዝማሚያ እንዲስፋፋ እያደረገ ይገኛል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በወንጌላዊያን ቡድኖች፣ ከእስራኤል ጋር ባላቸው ጠንካራ ግንኙነት እና በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪዎች ድጋፍ እየተጠናከረ ነው። እነዚህ ወጣት ፖለቲከኞች አወዛጋቢ የሆኑ ይዘቶችን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመጠቀም ሰፊ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት እና የክልሉን የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ለመቀየር እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Filaviyoo Bolsonaaroon filannoo duraa kan Biraazil keessatti Lula da Siilvaa wajjin dorgomaa jiru, kunis Latin Ameerikaa keessatti gara mirgaatti kan goru jijjiirama siyaasaa agarsiisa. Sochii kana kan gargaaraa jiran gareewwan amantii, hariiroo Israa'el wajjin qaban, akkasumas dargaggoota miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti beekamtii qaban kanneen qabiyyee mormisiisaa ta'e fayyadamanii siyaasa isaanii babal'isanidha. Dargaggoonni kunneen miidiyaa hawaasummaa fi ergaa cimaa fayyadamuun naannichaa keessatti jijjiirama siyaasaa fiduuf carraaqaa jiru.

title: ‘Turkey is a common enemy’: Pro-Israel network forms parliamentary groups in Greece and Cyprus
english: Influential pro-Israel lobbying groups are strengthening their political presence in Greece and Cyprus by establishing new parliamentary caucuses and holding high-level meetings with officials. These efforts aim to build security partnerships involving Israel and the United States while specifically framing Turkey as a shared regional adversary. The initiative underscores a strategic push to deepen Israel’s diplomatic and political influence across the Eastern Mediterranean.
amharic: ለእስራኤል ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ሎቢ ቡድኖች በግሪክ እና በቆጵሮስ የፓርላማ ቡድኖችን በመመስረት በክልሉ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ እያጠናከሩ ይገኛሉ። ቡድኖቹ ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር የፀጥታ አጋርነት ለመፍጠር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ቱርክን እንደ የጋራ ጠላት በመፈረጅ አገራቱን በእስራኤል ዙሪያ ለማሰባሰብ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በእስራኤል እና በመካከለኛው ምሥራቅ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የፖለቲካ ግንኙነት ለመቀየር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gumiiwwan Israa’eliif falman kan ta’an, Giriikii fi Qophroos keessatti gareewwan paarlamaa hundeessuudhaan dhiibbaa siyaasaa isaanii cimsaa jiru. Gareewwan kun Israa’elii fi Ameerikaa waliin walitti dhufeenya nageenyaa uumuuf hojjachaa jiru; akkasumas Turkeen akka diina gamtaatti ibsuudhaan biyyoota kana Israa’el biratti walitti fiduuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun dhiibbaa diiplomaasii fi siyaasaa Israa’el baha Meditarraaneenii keessatti guddifachuuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Gaza bakeries forced to shut as Israel blocks flour shipments
english: Most commercial bakeries in Gaza have suspended operations after Israel blocked vital wheat flour shipments for the past ten days. This shortage has created a severe food crisis, leaving thousands of residents struggling to access bread and threatening widespread famine. Local officials are calling on the international community to intervene, warning that the lack of food supplies is causing a dangerous rise in malnutrition among vulnerable groups.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ አብዛኞቹ የንግድ ዳቦ መጋገሪያዎች እስራኤል የስንዴ ዱቄት እቃዎችን ለተከታታይ አስር ቀናት በማገዷ ምክንያት ስራቸውን አቁመዋል። ይህ የዱቄት እጥረት ከፍተኛ የምግብ ቀውስ የፈጠረ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎች ዳቦ ለማግኘት ሲቸገሩ እና የረሃብ አደጋም ተጋርጦባቸዋል። የጋዛ ባለስልጣናት በአስቸኳይ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ዓለም አቀፉን ማህበረሰብ የሚጠይቁ ሲሆን፣ የምግብ እጥረቱ በተለይም በህጻናት እና በዕድሜ የገፉ ሰዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጦት እያስከተለ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti booddeewwan daabboo gurguddoon hedduun Israa'el ergaa daakuu qamadii guyyoota kudhan darbanif dhorkattee booda hojii dhaabaniiru. Hanqinni daakuu kun rakkoo nyaataa cimaa uumeera; namoonni hedduun daabboo argachuuf rakkachaa jiru, akkasumas sodaan beelaa babal'achuu dabaleera. Qaamoleen mootummaa Gaza hawaasni addunyaa dhimma kana irratti akka tarkaanfii fudhatu gaafachaa jiru, akkasumas hanqinni nyaataa kun daa'immanii fi maanguddoota gidduutti rakkoo fayyaa cimaa uumaa akka jiru akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Nigeria and Kenya Ebola patients may have crossed paths at Uganda airport, officials say
english: Health authorities are investigating a potential link between two Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya that both passed through Uganda's Entebbe airport on October 3. Officials are examining whether the individuals could have come into contact or shared facilities while at the airport, though no direct connection has been confirmed yet. Experts are currently analyzing the movements of both patients to determine the source of their infections.
amharic: የጤና ባለሥልጣናት በጥቅምት 3 ቀን በኡጋንዳ ኤንቴቤ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በኩል ካለፉ ሁለት የኢቦላ ታማሚዎች መካከል ሊኖር የሚችል ግንኙነትን እያጣሩ ነው። ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው ውስጥ እያሉ በአካል ተገናኝተው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ወይም ተመሳሳይ አገልግሎቶችን ተጠቅመው ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየተመረመረ ይገኛል፣ ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ ግንኙነት ባይኖርም። ባለሙያዎች የኢንፌክሽኑን ምንጭ ለመለየት የሁለቱንም ታማሚዎች እንቅስቃሴ በመከታተል ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa fayyaa dhukkubsattoota Ebola lama kan Naayijeeriyaa fi Keeniyaa irraa ta'anii fi Onkoloolessa 3tti buufata xiyyaaraa Entebbe kan Ugaandaa keessa darban gidduu hariiroo uumamuu danda'u qorachaa jiru. Namoonni kunneen buufata xiyyaaraa sanatti wal arguun ykn meeshaalee wal fakkaataa fayyadamuun danda'amuu isaanii kan qoratan ta'us, hanga ammaatti hariiroon kallattii tokko hin mirkanaa'e. Ogeeyyiin kunneen burqaa dhibee kanaa adda baasuuf sochiin dhukkubsattoota lamaanii xiyyeeffannoon hordofaa jiru.

title: Grenade exercise sparked deadly fire at Canada military base, army says
english: A training exercise involving live grenades at a Canadian military base in Alberta resulted in a catastrophic fire that killed four soldiers and injured nearly 40 others. Strong winds caused the flames to spread rapidly from the grenade range into a nearby area where troops were conducting combat drills. This tragedy occurred while the soldiers were preparing for an upcoming deployment to Latvia, marking one of the deadliest peacetime incidents in the history of the Canadian Armed Forces.
amharic: በአልበርታ ካናዳ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ የተደረገ የቀጥታ የእጅ ቦምብ ልምምድ፣ አራት ወታደሮችን የገደለ እና ወደ 40 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ያቆሰለ አስከፊ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። ኃይለኛ ነፋስ እሳቱን ከቦምብ መወርወሪያው ስፍራ ወደ ወታደሮች መለማመጃ ቦታ በማዛመቱ ጉዳቱ እንዲባባስ አድርጓል። ወታደሮቹ ወደ ላቲቪያ ለሚደረግ የሰላም ማስከበር ስምሪት በዝግጅት ላይ ሳሉ የደረሰው ይህ አደጋ፣ በካናዳ ጦር ሰራዊት ታሪክ ውስጥ ከታዩ በጣም አሳዛኝ የሰላም ጊዜ አደጋዎች አንዱ ሆኗል።
oromo: Buufata waraanaa Kaanaadaa kan Alberta keessatti leenjii boombii harkaatti fayyadamee godhameen, ibidda nama afran ajjeeseefi namoota 40 ol miidhe dhaqqabeera. Qilleensi cimaan ibidda kana bakka boombiin itti darbatamu irraa gara bakka waraanni leenjii itti taasiisaa jiruutti saffisiisuun miidhaan akka guddatu godheera. Waraanni kun gara Latviyaa deemuuf qophiirra osoo jiranii kan mudate kun, seenaa waraana Kaanaadaa keessatti balaa yeroo nagaa kanneen gurguddaa fi gaddisiisoo ta'an keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: Keeping Madhubala alive: The fight for Karachi’s captive elephants
english: Activists are fighting to save Madhubala, an African elephant currently living in captivity in Karachi, Pakistan, after her sister Noor Jehan passed away due to poor living conditions. These elephants were brought from Tanzania in 2009 and have struggled with medical issues caused by an inadequate environment. Concerned citizens and international organizations are now pressuring authorities to improve care or relocate the remaining elephants to a sanctuary, following the successful rescue of other captive elephants in the region.
amharic: በካራቺ ፓኪስታን የሚገኙ አክቲቪስቶች ማድሁባላ የተባለችውን የአፍሪካ ዝሆን በአግባቡ ባለመያዟና በጤና እክል ምክንያት ህይወቷ እንዳያልፍ እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። ዝሆኖቹ እ.ኤ.አ በ2009 ከታንዛኒያ ወደ ፓኪስታን የመጡ ሲሆን፣ አሁን የሚገኙበት የእንስሳት መጠለያ ለጤንነታቸው ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ሌሎች ዝሆኖች ከዚህ ቀደም ወደ ተሻለ ቦታ እንዲዛወሩ የተደረገውን ጥረት በማስታወስ፣ አክቲቪስቶቹ የቀሩትን ዝሆኖች ወደ መጠለያ ቦታ እንዲቀየሩ መንግስትን እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Hojjetoonni mirga foonii fi lubbu qabeeyyii Paakistaan, magaalaa Kaaraachii keessatti arbi Maadhubaala jedhamtu kun akka hin duuneef qabsoo taasisaa jiru. Arbi kun fi obboleettiin ishee kanaan dura duute, bara 2009 biyya Taanzaniyaa irraa gara Paakistaanitti fiduun ishee ni yaadatama; taa'umsi isheen keessa jirtus fayyaaf ishee mijataa miti. Gargaartoonni fi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa, arboonni kunneen iddoo gaariitti akka jijjiiramanii fi kunuunsa barbaachisu akka argatan mootummaa gaafachaa jiru.

title: Israel arrests 36 Palestinians in the West Bank, attacks on farmers ramp up
english: Israeli forces recently conducted raids across the occupied West Bank, resulting in the arrest of 36 Palestinians. Simultaneously, there has been a significant increase in attacks by settlers and security forces against farmers during the critical olive harvest season. These incidents, which involve violence, crop theft, and the destruction of trees, are severely hindering the agricultural livelihoods of the Palestinian people.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባካሄደው ተከታታይ ወረራ 36 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። በዚሁ ወቅት የወይራ ምርት በሚሰበሰብበት ወሳኝ ወቅት በአርሶ አደሮች ላይ የሚደርሰው ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የሰብል ዝርፊያን፣ የዛፎች ውድመትን እና በአርሶ አደሮች ላይ የሚፈጸም ጥቃትን የሚያካትቱ ሲሆን የፍልስጤማውያንን የኑሮ ምንጭ ለአደጋ እየዳረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa gara dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin namoota Palastiny 36 to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Yeroo kana keessatti, yeroo midhaan zaytun itti haamamu kanatti qonnaan bultoota irratti haleellaan raawwatamu dabalee jira. Haleellaan kunneen saaminsa midhaanii, mancaatii muka zaytunaa fi qonnaan bultoota irratti miidhaa geessisuudhaan jireenya fi bu'uura dinagdee uummata Palastiny irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: US tech stocks tumble as investors fret over AI spending
english: Major US technology stocks experienced a significant sell-off as investors expressed concern regarding the massive spending companies are dedicating to artificial intelligence. Large firms like Meta and Nvidia saw notable declines in share value after profit reports failed to meet expectations or signaled ballooning expenses. Additionally, the market was further impacted by rising global oil prices linked to ongoing regional tensions in the Middle East.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች አክሲዮኖች፣ ኩባንያዎች በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ላይ የሚያወጡት ከፍተኛ ወጪ አሳሳቢ በመሆኑ ዋጋቸው በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። እንደ ሜታ እና ኤንቪዲያ ያሉ ታዋቂ ድርጅቶች ትርፋቸው ከሚጠበቀው በታች በመውረዱ ወይም ወጪያቸው መጨመሩን በመግለጻቸው የአክሲዮን ዋጋቸው ወርዷል። ከዚህም በላይ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት የነዳጅ ዋጋን በመጨመሩ በገበያው ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gurguddoon qooda qabeenya teeknoolojii Ameerikaa gatiin isaanii kan hir'ate, abbootiin qabeenyaa baasii guddaa kampaniin guddina 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) irratti baasanirratti shakkii waan qabaniifi. Kampaniin gurguddoo akka Metaa fi Nvidia gatiin qooda qabeenya isaanii kan kufe, bu'aan isaanii kanneen eegamuun gadi ta'uu ykn baasiin isaanii daran dabaluu hordofee dha. Kana malees, walitti bu'iinsi naannoo Baha Giddu galeessaa gatii boba'aa waan dabaleef, kunis gabaa irratti dhiibbaa gad-aanaa geessiseera.

title: Venezuelans demand elections in first national protest in nearly two years
english: Thousands of Venezuelans recently held nationwide protests for the first time in two years, calling for the government to schedule free elections. Following the capture of former President Nicolas Maduro by U.S. forces, interim leader Delcy Rodriguez has remained in power without setting a firm date for a democratic vote. Opposition leader Maria Corina Machado is advocating for a transition to new leadership by July 2027 to address the country's ongoing economic and political struggles.
amharic: በቬንዙዌላ ባለፉት ሁለት ዓመታት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች ነፃ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ በመጠየቅ አደባባይ ወጥተዋል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ከተያዙ በኋላ፣ ጊዜያዊቷ ፕሬዚዳንት ደልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ስልጣኑን ቢቆጣጠሩም እስካሁን ምርጫ የሚካሄድበትን ቀን አልወሰኑም። የሃገሪቱ ተቃዋሚ መሪ ማሪያ ኮሪና ማቻዶ በኢኮኖሚ እና በፖለቲካ ቀውስ ውስጥ ላለችው ቬንዙዌላ እስከ ጁላይ 2027 ድረስ አዲስ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ ግፊት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Venezuela keessatti waggoota lama keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman filannoo bilisa ta'e akka geggeeffamu gaafachaa hiriira bahaniiru. Preezidaantiin duraanii Niikolaas Maaduuroo humnoota Ameerikaatiin qabamanii erga biyyaa ba'anii booda, pirezidaantiin yeroo Delisii Rodrigeez aangoorra turus, hanga ammaatti guyyaa filannoo hin murteessine. Hogganaan mormituu Maariyaa Koriinaa Maachaadoo rakkoo dinagdee fi siyaasaa biyyattii furuuf filannoon haaraan akka geggeeffamuufi haala kanaan jijjiirramni akka dhufu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
english: A recent BBC investigation has uncovered evidence that the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) deliberately and systematically targeted healthcare facilities in el-Fasher, Darfur, between 2024 and 2025. The findings reveal that over 40 attacks occurred, resulting in significant casualties among medical staff and the collapse of the city's health system. While UN officials state these actions may constitute war crimes, the RSF has denied the allegations, labeling the report as propaganda.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው በዳርፉር ኤል-ፋሸር ከተማ የነበሩ የሱዳን ፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) በጤና ተቋማት ላይ ሆን ብለው እና በስርዓት ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በሪፖርቱ መሠረት ከ40 በላይ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በርካታ የህክምና ባለሙያዎችን ለሞት እና ለጉዳት ከመዳረጉም በላይ የከተማዋን የጤና አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ አቋርጧል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የጦር ወንጀል ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ሲገልጹ፣ የRSF አመራር ግን ክሱን በማስተባበል ፕሮፓጋንዳ ነው ብለውታል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC dhiheenya kana gaggeesse akka mirkaneessetti, gareen waraanaa Sudaan kan RSF jedhamu magaalaa Daarfur, el-Faasher keessatti buufataalee fayyaa irratti beekaa fi karaa sirna qabuun haleellaa raawwateera. Qorannoon kun haleellaawwan 40 ol ta'an raawwatamuusaanii fi kanaanis hojjattoota fayyaa hedduun ajjeefamuu akkasumas sirni fayyaa magaalamtuu guutummaatti diigamuu isaa ibseera. Mootummoonni Gamtooman raawwiin kun yakka waraanaa ta'uu danda'a jechuun yoo himatan, gareen RSF garuu himannaa kana haaluun oduu sobaa fi kijiba jedhee waameera.

title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skin care sales
english: Cosmetics giant L'Oreal has noted that the growing popularity of weight loss medications is affecting the beauty and skincare market. Because rapid weight loss can lead to skin sagging, the company is now focusing on creating products specifically designed to address these aesthetic concerns. L'Oreal is also investing more in clinical dermatology to provide solutions for customers experiencing changes in their facial appearance after using these drugs.
amharic: የውበት መዋቢያ አምራቿ ሎሬል (L'Oreal) ክብደት መቀነሻ መድኃኒቶች በውበት እና በቆዳ እንክብካቤ ምርቶች ፍላጎት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ፈጣን የክብደት መቀነስ የቆዳ መለጠጥ እና መሸብሸብን ሊያስከትል ስለሚችል ኩባንያው ለእነዚህ ችግሮች መፍትሄ የሚሆኑ ምርቶችን በማምረት ላይ ትኩረት አድርጓል። በተጨማሪም ሎሬል ተጠቃሚዎች መድኃኒቶቹን በመጠቀም ምክንያት በሚያጋጥማቸው የፊት ገጽታ ለውጥ ላይ ውጤታማ መፍትሄዎችን ለመስጠት በቆዳ ህክምና መስክ ኢንቨስትመንቱን እያሳደገ ነው።
oromo: Hojjettoota miidhaginaa beekamtii qaban kan ta'e L'Oreal, qorichoonni ulfaatina qaamaa hir'isan gabaa miidhaginaa fi kunuunsa gogaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiraachuu beeksiseera. Ulfaatina qaamaa ariitiin hir'isuun gogaa gadi buusuu waan danda'uuf, dhaabbatichi rakkoo kana furuuf jecha oomishaalee addaa qopheessaa jira. Kana malees, L'Oreal namoonni qorichoota kana fayyadaman booda jijjiirama fuula isaanii irratti mul'atuuf furmaata kennuuf, damee yaala gogaa (dermatology) irratti investimentii isaa dabalaa jira.

title: Tibet rocked by 7.0-magnitude earthquake
english: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake recently struck the Tibet region in southwestern China, causing significant destruction. The disaster has resulted in the loss of at least 16 lives. This event marks the most intense seismic activity recorded in China since the beginning of 2024.
amharic: የ7.0 ማግኒቱድ መጠን ያለው ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በደቡብ ምዕራብ ቻይና በቲቤት ክልል ላይ ደርሷል። በዚህ አደጋ ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ይህ ክስተት ከ2024 መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በቻይና የተመዘገበው እጅግ ከፍተኛው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ነው።
oromo: ጂኦሎጂካል ፕሌት 7.0 kan ta'e sochiin lafaa cimaan tokko naannoo Tibet kan kibba-lixaa Chaayinaatti argamutti mudateera. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 16 ol ta'anii darbeera. Sochiin lafaa kun erga bara 2024 jalqabee biyyattii keessatti kan mudate isa hunda caalaa cimaa dha.

title: Iran war live: Trump hints new strikes, says US knocked ‘hell out’ of Iran
english: President Donald Trump has suggested that the United States may launch additional military strikes against Iran, claiming the U.S. has already inflicted significant damage. This warning follows a major incident in the Strait of Hormuz, where seven oil tankers were damaged in a single day. The event represents a notable escalation in the ongoing conflict between the U.S.-Israel coalition and Iran.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን እንደምትወስድ ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ የዛቻ መግለጫ የወጣው በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰላጤ በሰባት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ከደረሰ በኋላ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doolard Tiraamp ammaan booda tarkaanfiin waraanaa Itoophiyaa irra darbee Iran irratti fudhatamuu danda’u akka jiru eeraniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga markaboonni boba’aa torba galaana Ormuz keessatti miidhamanii boodadha. Taatee kun walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa fi Israa’el giddutti adeemsifamuun Iran irratti taasifamu daran jabaachaa akka jiru argisiisa.

title: UK Conservative Party leader responds to Al Jazeera investigation
english: UK Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch has publicly condemned the actions of Jack Ross, a former party member and candidate. This response follows an Al Jazeera investigation that exposed Ross discussing hired assassins and his involvement in connecting a far-right activist to others. The party has officially distanced itself from his controversial conduct.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የኮንሰርቫቲቭ ፓርቲ መሪ ኬሚ ባዴኖክ የቀድሞ የፓርቲው አባል እና እጩ የነበረው ጃክ ሮስ የፈጸመውን ድርጊት አውግዘዋል። አልጀዚራ ባደረገው ምርመራ ጃክ ሮስ ስለ ኮንትራት ነፍሰ ገዳዮች ሲወያይ እና ከጽንፈኛ የፖለቲካ አራማጆች ጋር ግንኙነት ሲፈጥር መገኘቱን ይፋ አድርጓል። ፓርቲው ከዚህ አሳፋሪ የሮስ ድርጊት ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስታውቋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Paartii Konservativii UK Keemii Baadeenook, miseensa paartichaa duraanii fi kaadhimamaa ture Jaak Roos gocha inni raawwate balaaleffataniiru. Qorannoon Al Jazeera akka ibsetti, Jaak Roos namoota ajjeesuudhaaf nama qacaruu fi sochii garee mirga-duree waliin walqabatu irratti hirmaachuun isaa saaxilameera. Paartiin kun gocha roos kun fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu fi ofirraa qabuusaa ibseera.

title: Hundreds of Ethiopians cross into Kenya to flee regional fighting
english: Hundreds of Ethiopian citizens, primarily women and children, have sought refuge in Kenya following violent clashes in the border town of Moyale. The unrest was triggered by a dispute over the display of a regional flag, leading to fighting between forces from the Oromia and Somali regions. The Kenya Red Cross is currently providing emergency shelter and supplies to the displaced families as they assess the situation.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ሞያሌ ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰ ግጭት ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ሴቶችና ህፃናት፣ ወደ ኬንያ ተሰደዋል። ግጭቱ የተቀሰቀሰው በአካባቢው ክልል ሰንደቅ ዓላማ አሰቃቀር ላይ በተነሳ አለመግባባት በኦሮሚያ እና በሶማሌ ክልል ኃይሎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ውጥረት ነው። የኬንያ ቀይ መስቀል ማህበር ለተፈናቃዮቹ መጠለያ እና አስፈላጊ የምግብ ቁሳቁሶችን በማቅረብ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Godina aanaa Moyyaaleetti walitti buiinsa uumameen walqabatee, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman, keessattuu dubartoonniifi ijoolleen, gara biyya Keeniyaatti baqatan. Walitti bu'insi kun kan ka'e alaabaa naannoo tokko ol kaasuun walqabatee humnoota naannoo Oromiyaafi naannoo Sumaale gidduutti erga uumamee booda. Waldaan Fannoo Diimaa Keeniyaas namoota baqatan kanaaf iddoo qubataafi gargaarsa nyaataa dhiheessuuf hojjataa jira.

title: Trump says Musk has restored Ukraine's access after Starlink row
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that Elon Musk has restored full Starlink internet access to Ukraine following a period of restricted speeds that hindered military operations. While President Volodymyr Zelensky noted that full service had not yet been completely recovered as of Thursday, reports suggest a private conversation between Trump and Musk led to the lifting of these connectivity limits. This situation highlights the critical dependence of the Ukrainian military on Musk's satellite technology for battlefield communications and drone operations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ኢሎን ማስክ የዩክሬን የስታርሊንክ ኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ መመለሱን አረጋግጠዋል። በዩክሬን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሮ የነበረው የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት መገደብ፣ በትራምፕ እና በማስክ መካከል በተደረገ ውይይት እንደተፈታ ይነገራል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ አገልግሎቱ ገና ሙሉ በሙሉ አልተመለሰም ቢሉም፣ ይህ ክስተት የዩክሬን ጦር ለጦር ሜዳ ግንኙነት እና ለድሮን ስራዎች በስታርሊንክ ቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጥገኝነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp, Elon Maaski tajaajila interneetii Staarlinkii kan Yuukreeniif deebisee guutuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Dhibbaan ariitii interneetii kun tarkaanfii waraana Yuukreen irratti gufuu ta'ee kan ture yoo ta'u, marii Traampii fi Maaski gidduutti godhame kanaan akka furame himama. Pireezidaanti Vooloodiimiir Zelenski tajaajilli sun ammayyuu guutummaatti hin deebine jedhanii ibsanillee, taateen kun waraanni Yuukreen qunnamtii dirree waraanaa fi hojii dooniiwwan (drones) isaanii geggeessuuf teeknoolojii Staarlinkii irratti hangam akka hirkatan agarsiisa.

title: Ecuador opposition leader Luisa Gonzalez arrested in campaign finance probe
english: Luisa Gonzalez, an Ecuadorian opposition leader and former presidential candidate, was arrested on charges related to illegal campaign financing during her 2023 election bid. Authorities suspect that about $500,000 was moved through an unauthorized network of entities to hide the true source of campaign funds. Gonzalez and her political movement have denied these allegations, labeling the arrest as a form of political persecution by the current government.
amharic: የኢኳዶር የተቃዋሚ መሪ እና የቀድሞ የፕሬዚዳንት እጩ ሉዊሳ ጎንዛሌዝ እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ወቅት በተፈጸመ የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ታሰሩ። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጋ የአሜሪካ ዶላር የገንዘብ ምንጩን ለመደበቅ ባልተፈቀደ መንገድ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል። ጎንዛሌዝ እና የፖለቲካ ድርጅታቸው ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ እስሩ በአሁኑ መንግስት የተቃጣባቸው የፖለቲካ አድማ ነው ሲሉ ኮንነዋል።

Abbootiin alangaa akka jedhanitti, qarshiin gara kuma 500 ta'u maddasaa dhoksuuf jecha karaa seeraan alaa ta'een akka socho'e shakkameera. Goonzaaleez fi dhaabbanni siyaasaa ishee himannicha haaluun, hidhichi mootummaa amma jiruun siyaasaa irratti xiyyeeffatee kan gaggeeffame akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Michigan voters closely divided between Rogers and El-Sayed
english: As the midterm elections approach, voters in Michigan remain split between Republican candidate Mike Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed for the U.S. Senate seat. Recent campaign activities highlight the tight competition between the two contenders. Some voters have raised personal questions regarding the candidates during public events, reflecting the intense atmosphere of this race.
amharic: የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫው እየተቃረበ ባለበት በአሁኑ ወቅት፣ በሚቺጋን ግዛት ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ሴኔት መቀመጫ የሚወዳደሩት ሪፐብሊካኑ ማይክ ሮጀርስ እና ዴሞክራቱ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በድምጽ ብልጫ እኩል ተቀራራቢ ሆነዋል። በቅርቡ በተካሄዱ የቅስቀሳ መድረኮች ላይ ሁለቱ ተወዳዳሪዎች እጅግ ተቀራራቢ ፉክክር እያደረጉ መሆኑ ታይቷል። አንዳንድ መራጮች በሕዝባዊ ስብሰባዎች ላይ ስለ እጩዎቹ የግል ማንነት ጥያቄዎችን በማንሳታቸው የዘንድሮው የውድድር ሂደት ትኩስነቱን አሳይቷል።
oromo: Filannoon giddu-galeessa waggaa dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, filattoonni Michigan teessoo Mana Maree Senetii Amerikaatiif giddutti kan dorgoman Mike Rogers kan paartii Rippabilikaanii fi Abdul El-Sayed kan paartii Dimookiraataatii gidduutti qooddamaniru.
